stations: Rome (1466–c. 1491): humanist in the papal court circles and Pomponio Leto's academy; borrowed a Vatican codex for Barbo 25 Nov. 1485 | Naples (after 1491–?): some years (sources scarce); contacts with Pontano, Marullus, King Federico, Beatrice of Aragon | Rome (?–1523): secretary to Giulio de' Medici; patrons Giuliano della Rovere, Galeotto and Sisto Franciotti della Rovere; titular archbishop of Monemvasia after Musurus (1517), resigned 1520

name: Demetrios Rhallis Kabakes
died: Rome, aged 90, a few years before his son (i.e. before 1523)
arrival_occasion: fled Ottoman rule with his son Manilius
